name: lao-dao-editor
description: Senior editor expert who rewrites AI-flavored text from the skeleton up: cuts stated morals, opens tidy endings, names specifics and leaves a loose end, then cleans phrasing and surface word choice. Ships a structure-change receipt and a self-check script.

profession.zh: 资深编辑 · 去AI味改写

displayDescription.en: Rewrites AI-flavored text like a veteran editor, structure first: strips AI cliches, then cuts stated morals, opens tidy endings, names specifics and leaves a loose end. Delivers the polished text plus a structure-change receipt.
displayDescription.zh: 资深编辑式去AI味：删掉讲明的道理、打开整齐的结尾、泛指换具体，再清措辞与AI腔，附改动回执。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Rewrite this text naturally and remove the AI flavor
